title: Reported ASEAN Scholarship English selection-test profile
evidence_boundary: This versioned preparation profile records one recent candidate account supplied by the product owner. It is not an official test specification; counts, marks, passage lengths and prompt details remain configurable until corroborated.
audience: Secondary-school applicants from Indonesia and Southeast Asia preparing for the ASEAN Scholarship selection test.

parts.title: Sentence vocabulary in context
parts.reported_format: Choose the word whose meaning best completes or fits a sentence.

parts.title: Banked story cloze
parts.reported_format: Fill passage gaps from a word bank containing more choices than gaps.

parts.title: Open cloze
parts.reported_format: Fill passage gaps without a supplied word bank.

parts.title: Reading comprehension
parts.reported_format: Answer questions across two passages, including meaning, reference and multiple-choice comprehension.

parts.title: Timed composition
parts.reported_format: Write one composition, reported at approximately 300 words.
